## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link relevant issues.

## Verification

List the commands, normal entry points and failure cases exercised. Include
source/fixture revisions for compatibility or performance claims. Distinguish
local results from GitHub CI evidence.

## Scope and provenance

Mention remaining limitations, migrations and deliberate differences from pinned
IRRd. Preserve upstream licenses. Human and AI-assisted contributions are welcome;
the author is responsible for reviewing and testing the change.

Do not include credentials, private registry data or generated runtime databases.
